lines.text: Many learners say: I have seen him yesterday.
With yesterday, use the simple past.
Saw! I saw her last week.

data.why: With yesterday, use the simple past.

native.tip: Le passé composé français devient “saw” avec hier, la semaine dernière, etc.
native.caption: Tu dis “I have seen him yesterday.” ? Avec « hier », on utilise le passé simple : “I saw him yesterday.”. Écoute Carlos et répète avec lui ! Plus d'exercices dans l'appli Lexkite.
native.comment: Réponse : “saw”. Avec une date passée, on utilise le prétérit. Teste d'autres pièges avec un quiz gratuit : {link}

en.tip: The French passé composé becomes “saw” with yesterday, last week, and so on.
en.caption: Do you say “I have seen him yesterday.”? With a past time, use the simple past: “I saw him yesterday.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat with him! More exercises in the Lexkite app.
